title: Wix Templates
meta: Choose a Wix template and we customize it with your logo, colors, text and photos. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Wix templates, tailored to your brand
overview: Pick any template from the Wix library, or let us suggest two that suit your business. We start a site from it in your account, change the fonts, colors and layout to match your brand, delete the demo content and fill the pages with your own words and photos. You skip the cost of a fully custom design and still get a site that looks like yours.

pkgs.blurb: Your template, branded and filled with your content.
A tailored template with extra sections and a working form.
A template reshaped so it no longer looks like a template.
list: Up to 5 sections restyled or added

faq: Can I change the template later?

On Wix, a published site cannot be switched to another template without rebuilding the pages. That is why we help you pick well first. Colors, fonts and sections can still be changed freely afterwards.
Wix templates are included with your Wix account. Plans, domain and paid apps are billed by Wix to you. Our price covers the setup and styling only.
Yes. Tell us what you do and the style you like, and we send two or three template options with a short note on why each fits. You pick, then we start.
Can you add pages the template does not have?
Yes, within the package limits. We copy the template's own style so the new pages match, and we count them against the pages-filled limit in your package.
